name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: 2 campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, spending $42.10 across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, but no leads came in.
points: Dedicated night runs took all of the day's activity: $42.10 spent, 2,300 impressions, 19 clicks, and a 0.8% click rate, with no leads. Regional Class A — Joliet had no spend, impressions, or clicks.
November 2026 has 28 days left. All spend so far this month — $42.10 — is on Meta.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) is mature: 33 were contacted, 17 made applicants, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is mature: 36 were contacted, 20 made applicants, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads and is too young to judge: 9 were contacted, 3 made applicants, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion.
